title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.32.0 warns when a data class property declared in the class body gets silently left out of equals() and copy().

highlights.title: Data Class Field Warnings
highlights.description: Flags properties declared in a data class body so you notice before equals(), hashCode(), or copy() silently ignore them.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added warnings for data class properties declared in the class body, since only primary constructor properties participate in the generated equals(), hashCode(), and copy(). It is a common source of subtle bugs.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be turned off via the kotlinJump.dataClassFieldWarnings setting.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Fixed an internal release check that could trigger false CI failure alerts, improving release reliability.
No other functional changes to extension behavior in this release.
